description: Sends Agentrica, anonymously, this project's token totals for the last 30 days (by day, agent, model and effort), which the site adds to those of other users. In two steps: 1) without code it returns the preview of what is sent and a code; 2) show the preview to the user, ask whether to send it and only after they say yes call the tool again with that code. Never send without the user's yes.

code.description: The preview code, only after the user says yes (second step).

name: share_usage
title: Send token totals to Agentrica
